summary: SS Innovations International, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an at-the-market (ATM) sales agreement with Virtu Americas LLC as exclusive agent. The registrant may offer and sell up to $50 million of common stock under its existing Form S-3 shelf registration. Sales will be made through an ATM program under Rule 415(a)(4), with Virtu receiving up to 3.0% compensation on gross proceeds. The filing includes customary representations, indemnities, and termination provisions. This is a routine capital markets transaction—an at-the-market equity distribution facility—without any change of control, merger, tender offer, activist involvement, restructuring, or other special situation. There are no deal terms involving premiums, break fees, or expected close dates.
